resources.string: A calm ledger. Fully offline — your money data never leaves this phone.
Add the places your money lives — bank, cash, cards, wallets.
Bank messages quote these. Without them Kosha cannot tell one bank\'s alerts from another\'s.
Kosha measures the gap between what comes in and what goes out. What lands each month?

Kosha can read bank alerts to log spends automatically. Only allowlisted bank senders are parsed. Only the amount, account, merchant and reference are extracted — the message text itself is not stored, and nothing ever leaves this device. OTPs and promotions are ignored. You can skip this and log manually — the app is fully functional without it.
Scan past bank messages so Kosha starts with real data. Safe to re-run — duplicates merge.
Logged %1$d transactions, %2$d waiting for review, from %3$d messages.
Budget heads-ups and bill reminders — at most one quiet digest a day. Everything works without them.

Use your fingerprint, face, or device PIN to open the app. Recovery is your device credential — Kosha never keeps its own PIN. If you remove your device lock or factory-reset, encrypted data is recoverable only from a backup file.
Eight short screens, once, covering everything below — the same map you\'d otherwise have to find by tapping around. Skip anytime; nothing here is required reading.

The ring shows money OUT this period — the number that actually needs a decision — with money in as the small figure beneath it. The weather line above it says whether you\'re ahead. Budget rings and any waiting review items sit below.
Opens straight to the camera for a bank SMS screenshot or a paper bill. Switch tabs for a manual entry (amount-first keypad, 3 taps) or to import existing screenshots from your gallery.

Every transaction, grouped by day. Swipe a row to recategorize, edit, split, or mark it as a transfer. The search bar doubles as a question box — try "dining last month" — and the filter icon opens the full query builder.

Where the flow of your money, spending rhythm, category shape, and 12-month trajectory live, alongside your financial health score, an advisor that explains its own reasoning, and leak/anomaly/what-if tools.
Reach budgets, sinking-fund goals, the debt payoff planner, net worth, and recurring bills from Home and Settings. Nothing here ever recommends a product — only your own numbers.

A separate lock for account numbers and cards you\'d rather not see on every ledger row. Reveal one field at a time with biometrics; it re-masks itself, and it never leaves this phone in an export or backup.
A PDF statement or CSV whenever you need one, and an encrypted local backup you control — no cloud, ever. Everything in this tour is reachable again from Settings.
Kosha asks for nothing at launch. Each permission below unlocks one feature, and the app stays useful with all of them off.
Reads allowlisted bank senders to log spends automatically. Only the amount, account, merchant and reference are extracted; the message text is not stored, and nothing leaves the device.
Off: log by hand or from a photo. Everything else is unaffected.
Scans receipts and UPI screenshots on-device.
Off: the Import tab still reads screenshots from your gallery, with no storage permission needed.
Budget heads-ups, bill reminders and a single daily review digest — never per-item pings.
Off: alerts simply do not fire. Nothing else changes.
Android treats SMS as a restricted permission for apps installed outside the Play Store. In app info, open the ⋮ menu and choose "Allow restricted settings", then turn SMS on.
Kosha has no internet permission at all, so no setting here can send your data anywhere.
Pick a date and Kosha shows only what happened on or after it. Everything earlier is hidden, not deleted.
Hidden entries keep their categories and edits. Move the date back and they return exactly as you left them.
Bank messages from %1$s to %2$s were never scanned, so that stretch may look emptier than it was.
Balances are now counted from %1$s onwards, so each account\'s opening balance should be what it held on that date. %2$d accounts to check.
PDF with charts, or CSV for a spreadsheet
One encrypted file, in a folder you choose
Read past SMS from a date you choose
No rules yet. Write one for yourself, or set a category limit Kosha can check automatically.
Violations are trending down over the last 30 days.
Violations are trending up over the last 30 days.
Violations are steady over the last 30 days.
Not enough history yet to show a trend.
e.g. \"No impulse buys over ₹5,000 without sleeping on it\"
Free-text rules aren\'t checked automatically — they\'re yours to judge, and Kosha never scores them.
Checked automatically against this calendar month\'s spend, and re-checked every time you open this screen.
Set this to your salary day so a \"month\" matches your pay cycle.

Your phone\'s brand stops apps from running in the background unless you allow it. If Kosha stops picking up new bank messages, turn on Autostart for Kosha in your phone\'s Settings → Apps → Kosha, and set its battery usage to unrestricted.
Ask for your fingerprint or PIN when opening Kosha
Off by default. On, the exact message text is stored so a wrong reading can be checked.
Kosha has no internet permission. Nothing here can leave this phone.
